system.description:
Named for the legendary (and supposedly fae) progenitor of the Anjou and Lusignan houses, this power grants a Toreador the ability to sway others through song. If the Artisan phrases her requests in song form, those words take on the power of nigh-irresistible commands. As an additional benefit, knowledge of this power reduces the difficulty of all rolls related to singing by one.

System: Initiating this power costs two blood points and a point of Willpower; the player writes down the suggestion woven into the song and the nature of the song itself. All those in earshot must roll Willpower (difficulty 8) or submit to the request without realizing they are doing so. The effect lasts as long as the Toreador sings or until the target leaves her presence; commands requiring the victim to leave can be resisted with an additional Willpower roll (difficulty 8) once the singing fades. Listeners not in her immediate presence may notice something odd (Wits + Subterfuge, difficulty 8) but perceive only an exceptionally good performance; other Toreador within earshot are immediately entranced.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book One: Artisans
system.duration: As long as the song continues
